|--------|---------------------------|---------------|

| **Spring** (Mar–May) | 55 °F – 68 °F (13 °C – 20 °C) | Gradually warming, less fog as spring progresses. Occasional showers early on. |

| **Fall** (Sep–Nov) | 56 °F – 69 °F (13 °C – 22 °C) | Similar to summer, though evenings cool down more quickly. Fog recedes after September. |
